serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: I have been fishing already for quite some time, but I feel like there’s no progress whatsoever… When I see the form and technique of Mrs.Fisher, I immediately realize that I still lack something, but I just can’t wrap my finger around what it is… I think I should ask her for some guidance. With her help, maybe I will be able to go to another level. You: Mrs. Fisher, I have a favor to ask… Mrs. Fisher: What is it? You: I think I hit a brick wall when it comes to fishing… You: I keep repeating the same mistakes and for a while now my skills have stopped improving. Could you maybe give me some tips or something like that? Mrs. Fisher: Hmmm…{{wi}} I think I know exactly what you need. You: R-Really?! Mrs. Fisher: Yeah. You need to smoke this. As she was saying that she pulled out something that appeared to be a joint… You: Really? I couldn’t help but sigh. You: No, I don’t think weed will help elevate my skills… #mrsfisher.Eyes.AngryClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry Mrs. Fisher: It’s not weed… #mrsfisher.Face.Angry Mrs. Fisher: Who do you think I am, huh?! Some junkie?! You: S-Sorry, of course not! #mrsfisher.Face.Normal You: …But if it’s not weed, what is it? Mrs. Fisher: It’s a combination of special seaweed extracted from dreamfish’s stomach and some very rare volcanic kelp. Mrs. Fisher: It’s been used by fishermen of the Canary Islands for centuries. Don’t ever compare this ancient tradition to something as crude as pot. This seems sketchy… You: And how is that, uh… {{wi}}seaweed joint supposed to help me get better at fishing? Mrs. Fisher: Thanks to its properties, it will help you to relax and find peace of mind. You: … You: I don't mean to sound rude, but how is it any different from weed? Mrs. Fisher: It’s entirely different. You: Ok, but how? Isn’t it like a narcotic? Mrs. Fisher: Of course not. It’s totally legal. Substances in it were never properly studied. You: That’s… That’s not how it works… Mrs. Fisher: Weed makes you hungry, sleepy, lowers your reaction time, gives you teary eyes… Mrs. Fisher: …Dries your mouth, increases your heart rate, makes your mind fuzzy… Mrs. Fisher: …It scares away fish, twists your bladder, makes you want to kiss other girls; in your case probably men, your farts become extremely long and high pitched and that’s only some of the side effects. Mrs. Fisher: You can’t fish properly on that crap! Mrs. Fisher: This on the other hand has absolutely almost no side effects and it is 100% safe and street legal. You: I don’t know about some of the stuff you said, but I guess it really is different from weed. Mrs. Fisher: Of course it is! Mrs. Fisher: Listen, I’m not forcing you to do it. I’m sure that in time you will make a breakthrough by yourself, but if you want to speed things up this is the only way. You: Ah! I get it! Let me do it. Mrs. Fisher: Here you go. Mrs. Fisher: Just don’t inhale too much, first time can be rough. You: You just said that it has no side effects! #mrsfisher.Face.Angry Mrs. Fisher: Stop complaining and get to it! You: Ok, ok! You don’t need to scream… #mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin Mrs. Fisher: Here you go. You: Ugh! It reeks! Mrs. Fisher: And what did you expect? It’s from a fish’s stomach. Grow up, kid. No one has ever died from puffing this yet. There’s always the first time… Whatever. I already have it in my hand, I can’t chicken out now. Here comes nothing! You: {{punch}}Cough, cough, cough! Mrs. Fisher: There you go, there you go. You: Woah, woah, what is happening? I feel like I’m losing my footing. Mrs. Fisher: Don’t worry, it only means it’s the good stuff and not that synthetic shit from the Czech Republic. Mrs. Fisher: Soon the worst will be behind you, so flumptorious quizzlewhacks blorping bibipoolaboob zibberflax. You: W-What? Mrs. Fisher: Didn’t you hear me? Wibblewobble frumdiddl schnookums. You: Oh no, you lied to me! This shit is much stronger!-
